cards.card_text: God says, "You shall not covet…" and then He keeps the list going.
cards.verse_text: You shall not covet your neighbor’s house.
cards.snippet: You shall not covet your neighbor’s house.

cards.card_text: God says not to covet a house, a wife, servants, an ox, a donkey or anything else that belongs to someone.
cards.verse_text: You shall not covet your neighbor’s house.
cards.snippet: You shall not covet your neighbor’s house.

cards.card_text: The last command is about the neighbor too: "You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife."
cards.verse_text: You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife.
cards.snippet: You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife.

cards.card_text: Moses warns Israel not to covet the silver and gold on the images of the nations' gods.
cards.verse_text: You must burn up the images of their gods; do not covet the silver and gold that is on them or take it for yourselves, or you will be ensnared by it; for it is detestable to the LORD your God.
cards.snippet: You must burn up the images of their gods; do not covet the silver and gold that is on them or take it for…

cards.verse_text: When I saw among the spoils a beautiful cloak from Shinar, two hundred shekels of silver, and a bar of gold weighing fifty shekels, I coveted them and took them.
cards.snippet: …shekels of silver, and a bar of gold weighing fifty shekels, I coveted them and took them.

cards.card_text: In the next line, someone covets more all day long.
cards.verse_text: All day long he covets more, but the righteous give without restraint.
cards.snippet: All day long he covets more, but the righteous give without restraint.

cards.verse_text: They covet fields and seize them; they take away houses.
cards.snippet: They covet fields and seize them; they take away houses.

cards.card_text: Paul says he never coveted anyone's silver or gold or clothing.
cards.verse_text: I have not coveted anyone’s silver or gold or clothing.
cards.snippet: I have not coveted anyone’s silver or gold or clothing.

cards.card_text: Then Paul lists commandments: “Do not commit adultery,” “Do not murder,” “Do not steal,” “Do not covet,” and any other commandments.
cards.verse_text: The commandments “Do not commit adultery,” “Do not murder,” “Do not steal,” “Do not covet,” and any other commandments, are summed up in this one decree: “Love your neighbor as yourself.”
cards.snippet: …“Do not commit adultery,” “Do not murder,” “Do not steal,” “Do not covet,” and any other commandments, are summed up in this one decree: “Love…

cards.card_text: They crave what they don't have, they kill and covet and still can't get it, and they quarrel and fight.
cards.verse_text: You crave what you do not have; you kill and covet, but are unable to obtain it.
cards.snippet: You crave what you do not have; you kill and covet, but are unable to obtain it.
